title: Subcounty Resident Population Estimates, California: April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025 (SUB-EST2025_6)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program
geography: Incorporated places and counties in California (rows used: Santa Monica, Burbank, Torrance, Beverly Hills, Downey, Santa Clarita and West Covina cities; Los Angeles County)
measures: Annual resident population estimates. Our arithmetic: change from the April 2020 estimates base to July 1, 2025 — Beverly Hills −5.9%, Torrance −5.8%, Downey −5.1%, Burbank −4.0%, West Covina −3.8%, Santa Monica −3.2%, Santa Clarita −1.9%, Los Angeles County −3.2%.
limitations: Model-based estimates revised each vintage; percentage changes are our calculation; residents only.

title: 2023 Gazetteer Files: Places, California
measures: Place names, GEOIDs, legal/statistical area type (LSAD 25 = city; 57 = census designated place) and land area in square miles. Used for land area (Beverly Hills 5.708, Santa Monica 8.409, Downey 12.409, West Covina 16.036, Burbank 17.316, Torrance 20.516, Santa Clarita 73.614 sq mi) and to confirm that Stevenson Ranch and Castaic are separate census designated places, not part of Santa Clarita city.
limitations: Reference geography file; persons-per-square-mile figures on our pages are our arithmetic combining it with ACS population.

title: City Profile
measures: States that the city incorporated in 1987 at 39 square miles including Saugus, Newhall, Valencia and Canyon Country, that neighborhoods have since been annexed, and that it is the third largest city in Los Angeles County, about 30 miles north of Downtown Los Angeles.
limitations: City promotional profile; rankings and descriptive claims on the page are not used.
